name: omnibridge/symfony
description: The Symfony host of omniscient/omnibridge's contracts (urls, translations, access, sessions, tokens, environment) - adapters over Symfony's router, translator, security and kernel, their container wiring and OmnibridgeBundle - and the framework packages omniscient/omnibase no longer requires. A Symfony site requires it beside the core.

suggest.omniauth/google: Google sign-in through Omnibridge\Symfony\Auth\ (omniauth.yaml: oauth.providers.google; its GoogleFactory is registered when it is installed)
suggest.omniauth/oauth: Identity providers through Omnibridge\Symfony\Auth\ (omniauth.yaml: oauth), each provider a package of its own (omniauth/google)
suggest.omniscient/omniauth: Omnibridge\Symfony\Auth\: one authenticator over omniauth for every way of signing in (password, sign-in link, e-mailed code, backup codes, trusted devices), its second factor's token and page, its routes; config/packages/omniauth.yaml (nothing of Auth\ without it)
suggest.symfony/asset: RouterUrls::asset() through the application's asset packages (assets.packages); without it, the path as it is
